items.title: Bob Stewart interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: they had a trombone player that was even louder than that and a guy named Joe Terra who dressed up in a clown’s outfit playing washboard.

ctx.x: Plectrum and tenor — loud as hell. Lord have mercy, loud as hell. And they had a microphone and they were singing, and they had a trombone player that was even louder than that and a guy named Joe Terra who dressed up in a clown’s outfit playing washboard. He was really good [scats]. He swung, actually. I mean he was killing. And they even had another guy that worked for NBC sports and he would play washboard with laying it on his lap but he would do it with knives. [scats] I mean these guys really did swing…
